Z7CP: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?
Whose is the son? Whose is the father?
DPHD: The Lord is the thug, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.
The Lord is the Enticer, who has enticed the world.
9KAE: I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ||1||Pause||
How shall I survive, my mother, in separation from God? Pause.
5SWZ: Whose husband is he? Whose wife is she?
Of whom is the husband? of whom is the wife.
8CKA: Contemplate this reality within your body. ||2||
Reflect you on this reality within your body.
CNGV: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and satisfied with the thug.
Says Kabir, with the Enticer, my mind is own propitiated.
1BLC: The effects of the drug have vanished, since I recognized the thug. ||3||39||
The illusion has vanished and I have recognised the illusionist.
WRM1: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.
The Sovereign Lord has, now, become my helper.
SFYH: I have cut away birth and death, and attained the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
Having, cut away coming and going, I have obtained the supreme rank. Pause.
AYZ9: He has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
He has united me with the saints congregation.
RJR8: He has rescued me from the five demons.
From the five demons, He has rescued me.
2ZM2: I chant with my tongue and meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Nectar Name, I continually repeat with my tongue.
3L3Z: He has made me his own slave. ||1||
The Lord has made me His slave without a price.
ZBVP: The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.
The True Guru has shown beneficence to me.
DJG8: He has lifted me up, out of the world-ocean.
He has rescued me from the world ocean.
SFH1: I have fallen in love with His Lotus Feet.
With Lord's lotus feet I have conceived love.
NYX7: The Lord of the Universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ||2||
The World-Lord, ever ever abides within my mind.
ET72: The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.
The burning coal of the fire of mammon has been quenched.
SCPL: My mind is contented with the Support of the Naam.
By Name's prop, my soul has attained contentment.
WBTR: God, the Lord and Master, is totally permeating the water and the land.
The Lord Master is fully pervading in Water and land.
JEAY: Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||
Wherever I see, there is the Knower of hearts.
MHET: He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.
His meditation, He has Himself implanted within me.
XA06: By pre-ordained destiny, one meets Him, O my Siblings of Destiny.
The Lord meets, O my brother, by virtue of the primal writ.
4NVA: When He grants His Grace, one is perfectly fulfilled.
Perfect becomes the condition of him, to whom the master shows mercy.
4EGF: Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ||4||40||
Kabir's Lord is the Cherisher of the poor.
TW70: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.
There is impurity in water, there is impurity in Land and there is impurity in Whatever is born.
Z6QB: There is pollution in birth, and more pollution in death; all beings are ruined by pollution. ||1||
There is impurity in birth, again there is impurity in death. The Lord's subjects are ruined by uncleanliness.
E0FB: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?
Says, O Pandit, who is pure?
Z213: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ||1||Pause||
Deliberate over such Knowledge, O my friend. Pause.
S9L8: There is pollution in the eyes, and pollution in speech; there is pollution in the ears as well.
There is impurity in the eyes, there is impurity in speech. There is impurity in the ears.
71T0: Standing up and sitting down, one is polluted; one's kitchen is polluted as well. ||2||
Standing and sitting impurity attaches to the mortal impurity enters the Kitchen.
XXS5: Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.
Everyone knows the way to be caught in impurity, but rarely anyone knows how to escape.
F6FW: Says Kabeer, those who meditate on the Lord within their hearts, are not polluted. ||3||41||
Says Kabir, no impurity attaches to those, who meditate on the Lord in their mind.
DQHP: Resolve this one conflict for me, O Lord,
PX5S: if you require any work from Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||
if you desirest any service from me, your slave. Pause.
R4XF: Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?
Is this soul greater, or He to whom this soul is attuned?
B4F3: Is the Lord greater, or one who knows the Lord? ||1||
Is the Lord greater, or He who knows the Lord.
HY7D: Is Brahma greater, or the One who created Him?
Is Brahma greater, or he who created him?
WKCL: Are the Vedas greater, or the One from which they came? ||2||
Is Veda greater, or the place from where it came?
TQDX: Says Kabeer, I have become depressed;
Says Kabir, I have become sad at this,
4R2Z: is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ||3||42||
is the place of pilgrimage greater or the God's servant.
ZV1G: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.
See brethren, the storm of Divine Knowledge has come.
C64P: It has totally blown away the thatched huts of doubt, and torn apart the bonds of Maya. ||1||Pause||
It is wholly blown away the thatched hut of doubt and even the bonds of mammon have not been left. Pause.
SEBX: The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of emotional attachment have come crashing down.
The two props of double-mindedness have been of worldly love has been broken.
3XRQ: The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has been broken. ||1||
The thatched roof of greed has fallen to the ground and the pot of bad intellect has burst.

R0VH: Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.
Your servant is saturated with the rain that has fallen after the storm.
00FW: Says Kabeer, my mind became enlightened, when I saw the sun rise. ||2||43||
Says Kabir, my mind is illumined, when I see the Sun rise.
GYT9: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the Guru's grace He is obtained.
D4PT: They do not listen to the Lord's Praises, and they do not sing the Lord's Glories,
They, who neither hear God's praise nor sing God's excellence,
SP4C: but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ||1||
but knock down the sky with their talk,
GH80: What can anyone say to such people?
What should one say to such people?
AXX4: You should always be careful around those whom God has excluded from His devotional worship. ||1||Pause||
They, whom the Lord has excluded from His devotional service, be you always afraid of them. Pause.
RPKF: They do not offer even a handful of water,
Themselves they give not even a handful of water,
F0MF: while they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ||2||
but slander him who brought down the Ganges.
6FJK: Sitting down or standing up, their ways are crooked and evil.
Sitting or standing, crooked are their ways.
B4F0: They ruin themselves, and then they ruin others. ||3||
They themselves are ruined and they ruin others.
QEXD: They know nothing except evil talk.
Save evil talk, they know nothing else.
2RGJ: They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ||4||
The obey not even Brahma's bidding.
EGLL: They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.
They themselves are gone amiss and they mislead others.
2KS5: They set their own temple on fire, and then they fall asleep within it. ||5||
Setting their mansion on fire, they sleep therein.
CQCK: They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.
They laugh at others though they themselves are one eyed.
MWRK: On beholding them, Kabir is ashamed.
5HUV: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the Guru's grace He is obtained.
LAGV: He does not honor his ancestors while they are alive, but he holds feasts in their honor after they have died.
One serves not his ancestors when they are alive, but he gives them feasts when they are dead.
B8Z7: Tell me, how can his poor ancestors receive what the crows and the dogs have eaten up? ||1||
Say, how shall the poor parents obtain what the crows and dogs have eaten up?
Z08L: If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!
Let some one tell me what the "real joy" is.
CAPZ: Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found? ||1||Pause||
Talking of real satisfaction, the world is dying, How can spiritual appeasement be obtained? Pause.
X84D: Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.
Making goddesses and gods of clay, the mortals offer them living creatures.
2HDM: Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ||2||
Such are said to be your deceased parents, who cannot ask for what they want to have.
LL2P: You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, you shall suffer in terrible pain.
You behead living being and worship lifeless things. At the last moment, great shall be your suffering.
YRH5: You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||
You know not the worth of Lord's Name, you shall be drowned in the terrible world--ocean.
D97B: You worship gods and goddesses, but you do not know the Supreme Lord God.
You adore goddesses and gods, waver in your faith and know not the supreme Lord.
8ZQD: Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestors; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ||4||1||45||
Says, Kabir, you have not remembered the ancestorless Lord and are clinging to the deadly sins.
VT7E: One who remains dead while yet alive, will live even after death; thus he merges into the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.
Man ought to remain dead in life, and being so dead should revive, again, through the Name. Like this he is absorbed in the formless Lord.
PF02: Remaining pure in the midst of impurity, he will never again fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
By remaining pure amid impurity, he falls not again, into the terrible world-ocean.
CBX4: O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.
My Master such milk should be churned.
VHET: Through the Guru's Teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
Under Guru's instructions, keep your mind steadfast. In this way shall you drink the Name Nectar. Pause.
QLL8: The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and the state of enlightenment has dawned.
The Guru's arrow has pierced the Dark-age and the state of illumination has dawned upon me.
960Y: In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ||2||
Due to the darkness of mammon my mistaking the rope for a snake, is ended and I now abide in the Lord's eternal mansion.
2VME: Maya has drawn her bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O Siblings of Destiny.
The mammon has stretched the bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O my brethren.

93LS: The drowning person is blown around in the ten directions by the wind, but I hold tight to the string of the Lord's Love. ||3||
In ten directions, the drowned mortal moves about in the wind, but I keep myself attached to the string of Lord's love.
96BZ: The disturbed mind has been absorbed in the Lord; duality and evil-mindedness have run away.
The perturbed mind is absorbed in the Lord, and duality and evil intellect have fled.
7MDC: Says Kabeer, I have seen the One Lord, the Fearless One; I am attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||46||
Says Kabir, by imbibing affection for Lord's Name I have seen the fearless Unique God.
9FRC: I turned my breath inwards, and pierced through the six chakras of the body, and my awareness was centered on the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.
By turning my thought towards God, I have pierced the six body rings and my mind got enamoured of the Lord.
GHUS: Search for the One who does not come or go, who does not die and is not born, O renunciate. ||1||
O World-renouncer search Him, who comes and goes not, and who neither dies nor is born.
9CRR: My mind has turned away from the world, and is absorbed in the Mind of God.
Turing away from the world, my soul is merged into the Supreme soul.
VGBX: By Guru's Grace, my understanding has been changed; otherwise, I was totally ignorant. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's grace, my understanding has become different otherwise I was quite ignorant. Pause.
6VLM: That which was near has become distant, and again, that which was distant is near, for those who realize the Lord as He is.
What was near has become distant, and again, what was distant has become near for him who realises the Lord as He is.
94KL: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ||2||
As is the sugary water made from sugar candy, only he who drinks it knows its relish.
XXV9: To whom should I speak Your speech, O Lord; it is beyond the three qualities. Is there anyone with such discerning wisdom?
To whom shall I narrate Your discourse, O Lord, which is beyond three qualities? Is there any such discriminating person.
9X44: Says Kabeer, as is the fuse which you apply, so is the flash you will see. ||3||3||47||
As is the fuse of spiritual understanding that one applies so is the Diving flash, which he sees.
L15E: There is no rainy season, ocean, sunshine or shade, no creation or destruction there.
There with the Lord is no rainy season, ocean, sun shine and shade. There is no creation or destruction.
JE58: No life or death, no pain or pleasure is felt there. There is only the Primal Trance of Samaadhi, and no duality. ||1||
No life, no death, no sorrow or joy is felt there.
4HB9: The description of the state of intuitive poise is indescribable and sublime.
There is only profound trance and no duality. The discourse of Sahaj-state is peerless and ineffable.
HF4X: It is not measured, and it is not exhausted. It is neither light nor heavy. ||1||Pause||
Neither it is weighed nor is it exhausted it is neither light nor heavy. Pause.
QLSF: Neither lower nor upper worlds are there; neither day nor night are there.
Both the nether region and upper one are not there. Night and day too are not there.
MHDJ: There is no water, wind or fire; there, the True Guru is contained. ||2||
Again there is no water, wind and fire. The True Guru is there contained.
KQHR: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord dwells there within Himself; by Guru's Grace, He is found.
The inaccessible and inapprehensible one abides there within Himself.
ZXJ7: Says Kabeer, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||4||48||
By Guru's grace He is obtained. Says Kabir, I am a sacrifice to my Guru and I remain attached with the congregation of saints.
QHPR: With both sin and virtue, the ox of the body is purchased; the air of the breath is the capital which has appeared.
With both merits and demerits the body ox is bought and life appears as the capital.
R0CX: The bag on its back is filled with desire; this is how we purchase the herd. ||1||
In this way the herd has been purchased. the heart bag on the ox's back is filled from within with desires.
SJH7: My Lord is such a wealthy merchant!
Such wealthy Banker is my Lord.
BALR: He has made the whole world his peddler. ||1||Pause||
The whole world, He has made His pedlar. Pause.
V7V8: Sexual desire and anger are the tax-collectors, and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.
Lust and wrath are both the tax-gatherers and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.
ASJ8: The five elements join together and divide up their loot. This is how our herd is disposed of! ||2||
The five mortal sins meet and distribute the loot. Like this the herd ferries across (passes away).
Y9JW: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: This is the state of affairs now!
Says Kabir, hear O saints such has become the state of affairs now.
KZ1W: Going uphill, the ox has grown weary; throwing off his load, he continues on his journey. ||3||5||49||
Going uphill, am ox has grown weary and dropping his sack, he has proceeded on his journey.
TLE8: For a few short days, the soul-bride stays in her parent's house; then, she must go to her in-laws.
A Woman has four days in her Father's house, she must go to her Father-in-law's.
JJ6D: The blind, foolish and ignorant people do not know this. ||1||
The blind, stupid and childish folk, understand not this.
KLBN: Tell me, why is the bride wearing her ordinary clothes?
Say, why is the bride so heedlessly standing and trying her loin-cloth?
00Q3: The guests have arrived at her home, and her Husband has come to take her away. ||1||Pause||
The guests have reached the home and her Husband has arrived to take her away. Pause.
3632: Who has lowered the rope of the breath down, into the well of the world which we see?
Who is letting down the rope, in the will which we see?
Q9KG: The rope of the breath breaks away from the pitcher of the body, and the water-carrier gets up and departs. ||2||
The rope breaks away from the water-pot, and the water-drawer gets up and departs.
KQCB: When the Lord and Master is kind and grants His Grace, then her affairs are all resolved.
If the Lord be kind and shows His mercy, the woman shall set aright her affairs.

W8W1: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, if she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
Then alone she is considered to be the happy wife, if she ponders on the Guru's teaching.
517U: Bound by the actions she has committed, she wanders around - see this and understand.
Bound by the deeds done everyone wanders about, you should see and consider this.
S171: What can we say to her? What can the poor soul-bride do? ||4||
What shall we say to her? What can the poor one do?
GEL8: Disappointed and hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no support or encouragement in her consciousness.
Becoming hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no prop and satisfaction in her mind.
FUH2: So remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet, and hurry to His Sanctuary, Kabeer! ||5||6||50||
Remain attached to God's feet and flee to His asylum, O Kabir.
Q9G4: The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O Siblings of Destiny.
Yogi says that yoga and nothing else is good and sweet, O brother.
9Z1E: Those who shave their heads, and those who amputate their limbs, and those who utter only a single word, all say that they have attained the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas. ||1||
The shaven ones, of amputated limb and the one word utterers, they say that they have obtained perfection.
MJXV: Without the Lord, the blind ones are deluded by doubt.
Without God, the blind ones are gone astray in doubt.
CPDZ: And those, to whom I go to find release - they themselves are bound by all sorts of chains. ||1||Pause||
They, to whom I go to release myself, are themselves bound by many chains. Pause
FNKB: The soul is re-absorbed into that from which it originated, when one leaves this path of errors.
The soul is absorbed in Him, form where it issued when man forgets this sort of pride.
Q7R5: The scholarly Pandits, the virtuous, the brave and the generous, all assert that they alone are great. ||2||
The learned, the virtuous, the brave the generous, they assert that they alone are great.
HRL3: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Without understanding, what can anyone do?
He alone understands God, whom He causes to understand Him. How can one do without understanding Him.
H4T5: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled, and in this way, the jewel is obtained. ||3||
By meeting the True Guru. the darkness is dispelled. In this way, Lord the gem is obtained.
U4NP: Give up the evil actions of your left and right hands, and grasp hold of the Feet of the Lord.
Give up sins of your left hand and the right and take the firm hold of God's feet.
K14X: Says Kabeer, the mute has tasted the molasses, but what can he say about it if he is asked? ||4||7||51||
Says Kabir, the dumb man has eaten molasses, but what can he tell if questioned?
5KX6: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the Guru's grace He is obtained.
4MTE: Where something existed, now there is nothing. The five elements are no longer there.
Where there was something there is nothing now. The five elements are no more, there.
JVQD: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breaths through these be counted now? ||1||
The left nostril, the right one and the central tracheas, how can these, now be counted, O mortal?
LRWY: The string has been broken, and the Sky of the Tenth Gate has been destroyed. Where has your speech gone?
The string is broken and the brain is destroyed. Wither has the speech gone?
B4ZS: This cynicism afflicts me, night and day; who can explain this to me and help me understand? ||1||Pause||
Night, and day this anxiety haunts me. None can explain and make me understand this. Pause.
6FTL: Where the world is - the body is not there; the mind is not there either.
The body is not there where this world, is Its prompter (mind too) is not there.
HZ49: The Joiner is forever unattached; now, within whom is the soul said to be contained? ||2||
The Joiner is ever unattached. Within whom can this soul, now be said to be contained?
XLQY: By joining the elements, people cannot join them, and by breaking, they cannot be broken, until the body perishes.
By trying to unite the elements man cannot unite them. By trying to separate them, he cannot separate them, until the body perishes.
62E5: Of whom is the soul the master, and of whom is it the servant? Where, and to whom does it go? ||3||
Of whom the soul is the Lord and of whom the servant? Where and to whom can it go?
MXB4: Says Kabeer, I have lovingly focused my attention on that place where the Lord dwells, day and night.
Says Kabir, my love is centred on the place, where the Lord, day and night abides.
NYR6: Only He Himself truly knows the secrets of His mystery; He is eternal and indestructible. ||4||1||52||
His secret He Himself fully knows. He is ever Imperishable.
M7ZN: Let contemplation and intuitive meditation be your two ear-rings, and true wisdom your patched overcoat.
Meditation and contemplation of God, are my two ear rings and the true knowledge is my outward patched coat.
09LC: In the cave of silence, dwell in your Yogic posture; let the subjugation of desire be your spiritual path. ||1||
Contemplative posture is my dwelling in the silent cave and the abandonment of desire is my religious sect.
8JTL: O my King, I am a Yogi, a hermit, a renunciate.
My king, I am a yogi imbued with Lord's Love.
2MRZ: I do not die or suffer pain or separation. ||1||Pause||
I am above death, sorrow and separation. Pause.
DVP7: The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is the bag to carry my ashes.
In the universe and regions, I find my horn and the whole world is my wallet to keep the ashes.
8G47: Eliminating the three qualities and finding release from this world is my deep meditation. ||2||
Riddance of three qualities and release from the world is my sitting in trance.
C37G: My mind and breath are the two gourds of my fiddle, and the Lord of all the ages is its frame.
My mind and breath, I have made the two gourds of my fiddle and the Lord of all the ages I have make its frame.

B97U: The string has become steady, and it does not break; this guitar vibrates with the unstruck melody. ||3||
Stable has become the string and breaks not, and the fiddle plays spontaneously.
RKD2: Hearing it, the mind is enraptured and becomes perfect; it does not waver, and it is not affected by Maya.
By hearing it, the mind of the perfect man is enraptured and feels not the swaying of mammon.
ULTD: Says Kabeer, the bairaagee, the renunciate, who has played such a game, is not reincarnated again into the world of form and substance. ||4||2||53||
Says Kabir the desireless soul, which has played such a game is not born again.
FG8H: Nine yards, ten yards, and twenty-one yards - weave these into the full piece of cloth;
Weave this into a full piece of nine yards, ten yards and twenty one yards.
J6DA: take the sixty threads and add nine joints to the seventy-two on the loom. ||1||
To the warp of sixty threads and the woof of seventy-two, add another nine joints.
PARB: Life weaves itself into its patterns.
Said the soul who had gone to have the yarn woven.
PXMS: Leaving her home, the soul goes to the world of the weaver. ||1||Pause||
Leaving her former home, the soul goes into weaver's woven one. Pause.
QBJD: This cloth cannot be measured in yards or weighed with weights; its food is two and a half measures.
The body is not measured with yards or weighed with weights. Its food is two and a half seers.
X2VH: If it does not obtain food right away, it quarrels with the master of the house. ||2||
If the body obtain not food quickly, the soul quarrels and the body home is destroyed.
HCEK: How many days will you sit here, in opposition to your Lord and Master? When will this opportunity come again?
O you, averse to the Lord, soul, how many days are there for you to sit here? When shall you have this opportunity again?
4SRH: Leaving his pots and pans, and the bobbins wet with his tears, the weaver soul departs in jealous anger. ||3||
Leaving the pot and the wet bobbins the weaver soul departs in anger.
D1ZN: The wind-pipe is empty now; the thread of the breath does not come out any longer. The thread is tangled; it has run out.
The breath thread comes not out of the empty wind-pipe. Getting entangled the breath thread is exhausted.
GJ9B: So renounce the world of form and substance while you remain here, O poor soul; says Kabeer: you must understand this! ||4||3||54||
O wretched soul, while living here renounce you the world. Kabir says this to make you understand this.
SRTT: When one light merges into another, what becomes of it then?
One light merges into another light, can it be or be not separated again?
L875: That person, within whose heart the Lord's Name does not well up - may that person burst and die! ||1||
May that man, burst and die in whose mind God's name sprouts not.
2HJF: O my dark and beautiful Lord,
O my dark and beauteous Lord,
2B52: my mind is attached to You. ||1||Pause||
my mind is attached with You. Pause.
J2QF: Meeting with the Holy, the perfection of the Siddhas is obtained. What good is Yoga or indulgence in pleasures?
By meeting the saints perfection is obtained of what use if this Yoga-method and of what the revelments?
9LWD: When the two meet together, the business is conducted, and the link with the Lord's Name is established. ||2||
When two, the Guru and the disciple meet, the business is accomplished and the tie with Lord's Name is established.
ZARW: People believe that this is just a song, but it is a meditation on God.
People deem it to be a song but it is mediation on the Lord.
Z2LL: It is like the instructions given to the dying man at Benares. ||3||
It is like the instruction imparted to the man at the time of death at Banaras.
T71Y: Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with conscious awareness
Who-so-ever attentively sings or hears Lord's name,
HTRJ: - says Kabeer, without a doubt, in the end, he obtains the highest status. ||4||1||4||55||
says Kabir, doubtlessly he obtains the highest dignity at last.
3HX3: Those who try to do things by their own efforts are drowned in the terrifying world-ocean; they cannot cross over.
All those, who make efforts without God's Name, they are drowned and swim not across the terrible ocean.
E5JN: Those who practice religious rituals and strict self-discipline - their egotistical pride shall consume their minds. ||1||
Those who practise religious rituals and great self-discipline, the proud intellect consumes their soul.
D2R5: Your Lord and Master has given you the breath of life and food to sustain you; Oh, why have you forgotten Him?
Why have you, O man, forgotten in your mind, the Lord, who has given you life and food?
XFYG: Human birth is a priceless jewel, which has been squandered in exchange for a worthless shell. ||1||Pause||
The human birth is a priceless ruby and gem. For a worthless shell you have lost it. Pause.
4CDL: The thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt afflict you; you do not contemplate the Lord in your heart.
You sufferest from the thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt, as you reflectest not on God in your mind.
